description: Find coin records by puzzle hash. Returns coins locked to the given puzzle hash. Use include_spent_coins to also return already-spent coins. Optionally filter by height range. ⚠️ Coinset hosted nodes cap results at 50,000 records per request, and the chia-mcp server truncates responses over 50KB — results may be incomplete for active addresses. For balance lookups, use get_address_summary instead (it pages automatically and returns a complete flag). Use start_height/end_height to page through large result sets manually.

end_height.description: Only return coins created before this height

include_spent_coins.description: Include coins that have been spent (default: false, only unspent)

puzzle_hash.description: The puzzle hash to search for (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes hex)

start_height.description: Only return coins created at or after this height

name: get_coin_records_by_puzzle_hash
